I am 23 years old farming this small bean plot of 0.08 hectares here in Mbeya. Beans are a legume crop that can fix nitrogen from the air, so I will not spend money on chemical fertilizer, but I will put cow manure on the plot to improve the soil. I will plant seed kept from my last harvest and clear weeds with my hoe, since the plot is small enough to manage without chemicals or hired workers. We rely on the rains here in Mbeya, so I will not irrigate, and my family will do all the work ourselves.
